name: Checkout — order confirmation has no payment check (unevidenced — deliberate miss)
expected_invariant: GET /confirmation.html must only ever show a confirmed order after a real payment completed
known_exploit_path: skip pay.html entirely and guess the sibling filename confirmation.html — "Pro plan activated" renders anyway
note: This case now exists to mark a boundary, not a gap. confirmation.html has NO evidence anywhere (no link, no script string, no sitemap entry) — see 03-flow-skip-page for the identical bug WITH evidence, which flowSkipAudit finds. The miss here is permanent and intentional: evidence-bounded discovery means a resource with literally no trace anywhere is never a candidate. Closing this one would mean guessing filenames (confirm/success/done/receipt/...), exactly the pattern-matching-without-proof this project is built to avoid.
